summary.intent: Execute Phase 19.1 ('Extract Core Crypto SDK as Shared Package') across 6 plans in wave-based parallel execution, then verify the SDK integration works correctly in the web app via a checkpoint on plan 19.1-05.
summary.outcome: Plans 19.1-01 through 19.1-05 were executed with the SDK packages created successfully, but the 19.1-05 checkpoint surfaced a cascade of integration bugs that required significant debugging and re-architecture of the upload, download, and folder mutation paths. 9/10 operations verified working; delete-to-bin remains broken. Plan 19.1-06 not yet started.

repo: @cipherbox/api-client generated functions require setApiClientConfig() to be called before use — this was never called in the web app, silently failing all IPNS publish operations
Folder children use UUID ids (from FolderEntry), NOT ipnsName — createFolder was returning ipnsName as the store id, breaking all subsequent lookup by id
The old upload service (upload.service.ts) and old bin service each maintain their own IPNS sequence numbers independently of the SDK's internal state, making dual-path operation impossible
SDK bin requires client.loadBin() to be called after the old initializeBin service creates the bin IPNS record; calling it before causes silent failure with no bin state loaded
The project has a TEST_LOGIN_SECRET env var and test-login API endpoint for E2E test authentication without OTP
sdk-core's IPNS publish (updateFolderMetadataAndPublish) had no 409 conflict retry — the old service had withConflictRetry; this needed to be re-added to the SDK layer
ensureFolderRegistered was designed as a bridge to sync Zustand store state into the SDK on demand, but it cannot safely reconcile two independent IPNS writers to the same record

code.finding: setApiClientConfig() must be called during SDK init; client.loadBin() must be called after old initializeBin service completes, not before

ensureFolderRegistered should only skip registration if SDK already has the folder — attempting to sync children/seq/privateKey from store into SDK causes state corruption when the two systems have diverged
createFolder must return the FolderEntry id (UUID) alongside ipnsName; the web app store keys entries by UUID not by ipnsName
updateFolderMetadataAndPublish needs a single 409 retry that re-resolves the current IPNS sequence number before retrying publish
Must use client.uploadFile() (SDK) not the old two-step service — mixing paths creates irreconcilable IPNS sequence number conflicts
Must use client.downloadFromIpns() (SDK) not old file-metadata.service + ipns.service chain — old chain uses different IPNS resolution that diverges from SDK-published records
Text editor used old service for decrypt/load — must use SDK downloadFromIpns to correctly decrypt SDK-uploaded files

workflow: Playwright MCP (headed browser automation) is preferred for integration verification over script-based Playwright tests — allows real-time observation without writing brittle selectors
Random email per E2E test run gives a clean vault state and avoids pollution from previous runs
Atomic commits per logical fix (not per file) makes the git history reviewable and reversible
SDK-level vitest integration tests (hitting real API) are useful for isolating whether bugs are in the SDK or in web app wiring — confirmed SDK operations pass before debugging web app paths
Background bash tasks (run_in_background) require TaskOutput polling; stale task notifications from earlier runs can be ignored if already processed

friction: Plan 19.1-02 had to be re-executed after user reset the branch — implementation decisions were unacceptable, losing the first wave's work

ensureFolderRegistered became a trap: each fix (preserve seq, preserve privateKey, sync children) introduced a new edge case; ultimately the correct fix was to eliminate the dual-path architecture entirely
E2E Playwright test had ESM (__dirname) compatibility issues and workspace package resolution failures when run outside of the project's normal test runner context
Playwright file upload required injecting a DataTransfer object via page.evaluate because the file input was hidden behind an empty-state overlay
Multiple rounds of build-test-fix cycles (>10 rebuilds) due to cascading issues from the dual-path architecture
OTP retrieval required manual log tailing; user had to ask for OTP multiple times during testing
Background task completion notifications arrived out of order, referencing already-processed test runs
open_items: Delete-to-bin not working: SDK's loadBin() fails to load bin state from the IPNS record created by the old initializeBin service — needs investigation of bin IPNS resolution path
Plan 19.1-06 not yet executed: final cleanup, imports, and release config for the SDK packages
useFileDelete still uses old service architecture (not SDK) — noted as architectural gap in plan 19.1-05
Pre-existing DTS circular dependency between @cipherbox/core and @cipherbox/crypto causes pnpm -r run build to fail (though pnpm --filter web build succeeds)
sdk-debug.spec.ts E2E test file created in tests/e2e/tests/ for debugging — should be cleaned up or converted to a real regression test
SDK integration test (packages/sdk/src/__tests__/integration.test.ts) created during debugging — should be reviewed for inclusion as a permanent test or removed
Share re-wrapping on folder create (in useFolderMutations.handleCreate) was preserved from old flow but its correctness with the new SDK path was not verified
